text: Round 0 is an untested baseline, not a trial. Across four groups (400 candidates total, 100 per group, one trial each, ticks 4-6 over steps 10-90) incumbent and latest are identical, so every paired delta is exactly 0.0 with 100/100 common-valid, no validity conversions and win rate 0.0 (E003, E012, E022, E028); all quartile responses are 0 (E009). No schedule has failed yet - the proposals are forecasts. The per-chain TOP1 teacher (7.8378) is a selected search output from a limited budget and must be judged only against other selected TOP1s, never against the mean of the four unselected 100-candidate distributions (3.84-4.03). Learned: distributions are left-skewed and scaffold-dominated (sugar polyols 5.1-7.2 vs aromatic carboxylates 2.6-4.6 in G1), medians 3.44-3.51 against best 7.11-7.56. Guidance is near-inert: clip_factor 1.0 and clipped_fraction 0.0 everywhere, max atom displacement <=0.0041 A, native ratios 0.0-0.030. Future gains must not be credited to clipping relief or validity conversion; a first appearance of either would warn that the tick increase was too aggressive. Treat with suspicion: (1) 'more early ticks reliably tighten geometry' - identical 5-tick interval 0 gave step-25 core RMS 0.592 A in G3 but 2.678 A in G4 from the same ~3.2 A start (E018, E031); (2) 'highest observed group mean implies the best schedule' - cross-group paired means span only -0.190 to +0.143 at win rates 0.47-0.55, i.e. noise; (3) per-candidate drift as a score proxy (G3: c085 drifts most yet scores 3.80); (4) equating checkpoint RMS with rescored pIC50 - no within-round measurement links them. Unresolved: whether interval 2 is under-guided (G1) or futilely over-guided (G2); whether interval 3 ticks consolidate or are wasted; whether interval 0 acquisition or interval 1 maintenance dominates. What would change the conclusion: a nonzero common-valid paired Mean with validity still 100/100, especially a Mean gain above ~0.2 (about 2 SE at n=100); any first-time clipped_fraction >0; or step-25/step-90 RMS moving in the direction a proposal predicts. This reflection is not the final skills review.
